rules: Run both exact upstream-control and integrated candidate with identical game/map/mod/init/prefs inputs and architecture.
No new expected-desync entries, shortened replay windows, ignored checksums or regenerated goldens to obtain green.
A known failure in upstream-control establishes baseline context, not a candidate pass. All six remain acceptance blockers until actual evidence resolves them.

viewer_acceptance.upstream_reported_only: 6d64196 and d725bde describe 52 forward/backward seeks to every keyframe twice, whole map visible; these tests were not rerun here.
required: Forward/backward seek, first forward jump before viewer reaches target, cancellation/rapid repeated seeks, camera/focus/speed preservation.
No notify watcher access to destroyed units; no script errors, trail/history crashes or new checksum mismatch after replacement.
Flattened terrain restored from initial map copy; new replay and sequential replay cleanup preserve correct scene and decals.
Keyframe producer uses the same exact executable and --keep-client-data with matching /init and content.
PrepareKeyframes on/off comparison for CPU, RAM peak, disk transient and exit cleanup; 2048 MiB is a cache disk budget, not a total-memory bound.
Cold cache, no writable exe directory/temp fallback, disk-full/write failure, corrupt or incomplete .part files, child startup/exit and game shutdown.
Never load keyframes created by another executable/build; no runtime run/cleanup is authorized by this preparation.
D3D12/Vulkan packed bone batches and float4 bulk parameter copies, short/large batches, shader constants and descriptor rollover with #284.
D3D9/10/11 full-palette fallback unchanged visually; compare animated units and build ghosts per beat, camera views and replay rewind.
Existing #282 particle drag and #283 terrain shadow acceptance plus representative real large ZIP and mixed loading.

rejoin_acceptance.rule: Keep ordinary build defaults; test rejoin in an explicitly scoped scenario environment, preserve real orders/pause/handover/no-duplicate checks.

router_acceptance.build_scope: Separate explicitly authorized FAF_SERVER_MODE=ON validation, not ordinary main test settings.
required: Routed replay end/early stop/repeated runs, --tear-down on/off, driver shutdown before router release and no dangling callback; routing disabled control.
Recall votes/messages to each allied view, off-team announcements, defeat/resync, due tick status and view/focus changes; unchanged simulation/checksum.
Initial reclaim labels exact per beat, later visible/allied-visible labels, disappearance before first visibility, updates/deletion/ID reuse, reconnect restoration and no fog leaks.
Capture complete run, record beat coverage and independent visibility oracle; compare.py success alone is insufficient.
